summary: Fortis Inc. filed a Form 6-K (combined annual meeting results) disclosing that shareholders approved the election of directors, appointment of Deloitte LLP as auditors, and a non-binding say-on-pay advisory vote. There are no strategic transactions, activist campaigns, or special-situation events. The report is a routine disclosure of annual meeting voting outcomes, not a special situation. It maps to a US Form 8-K Item 5.07 equivalent for submitting shareholder voting results. No deal terms, premium, or structural changes are present. No action or risk-arb angle exists.
